howTo: Click “Choose PDF file” and select the document you want to number.
Pick a position — bottom center is the classic choice for reports, theses and books.
Choose a format such as “7”, “Page 7” or “7 / 42”, and set the starting number if needed.
Adjust font size, color and margin, then click “Add page numbers”.
Download the new PDF and spot-check the numbers in your PDF reader.
keyFacts: Page numbers are drawn directly onto each page with the standard Helvetica font, so they render identically in every PDF reader and printer.

add-page-numbers-to-pdf.workedExample:
On an A4 page (595.28 pt wide), the number “5 / 12” at 11 pt is about 34 pt wide. Centered at the bottom with a 36 pt margin:
x = (595.28 − 34) ÷ 2 = 280.64 pt from the left edge
y = 36 pt from the bottom edge
The number sits exactly centered, half an inch above the bottom of the page.
